jutsu.noirm.katon.fire_dragon: Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet

screen.noirm.ally.title: %s
screen.noirm.ally.teach.eyes: Needs eyes or a beast they don't have
screen.noirm.ally.teach.reserves: Their chakra reserves are too low for this rank
commands.noirm.clan.unknown: No clan called %s in this world (try /noirm clan list)
message.noirm.beast.trusts_more: …Hmph. You've earned a little more of my power.
message.noirm.beast.tail_unlocked: Fine. Take %s tails of my chakra. Don't make me regret it.
message.noirm.beast.not_trusted: You want more of my power? You haven't earned it, brat.
message.noirm.beast.seizes: You reached too far. NOW IT'S MY TURN!
message.noirm.beast.saves: Don't you dare die in here with me! Take my chakra!
message.noirm.beast.takes_chance: Weak... so weak. Let ME handle this!
message.noirm.beast.request.defeat: I'm bored. Crush %s enemies for me.
message.noirm.beast.request.release: Let me out. Wear my cloak for %s seconds.
message.noirm.beast.request.strong: Fight someone at least as strong as you. Show me something worth watching. (%s)
message.noirm.beast.request.offer: Bring me %s. Hold it, crouch and call me.
message.noirm.beast.request.rest: Leave me in peace for a while. No cloak. (%s)
message.noirm.beast.pleased: …Not bad. Maybe you're not completely useless.
message.noirm.beast.request_failed: You ignored me. I won't forget that.
message.noirm.beast.rest_broken: I told you to leave me alone!
message.noirm.beast.chakra_gladly: Here, partner. Take as much as you need.
message.noirm.biju.full_mode: Tailed Beast Mode: %s tails, as partners
commands.noirm.beast.status: %s · bond %s · unlocked %s of %s tails · safe to draw %s
commands.noirm.beast.kind.strong: defeat someone as strong as you
message.noirm.ally.leaves: %s has lost all respect for you and leaves the crew.
villager.noirm.line.adult.0: Lovely day for a walk, isn't it?
villager.noirm.line.adult.1: The ramen stand on the main street never closes. I swear the chef never sleeps.
villager.noirm.line.adult.2: Did you see that? Someone just ran across the rooftops again.
villager.noirm.line.adult.3: Our walls have never fallen. Not while the Kage sits in that tower.
villager.noirm.line.adult.4: My son wants to join the Academy. I told him to finish his chores first.
villager.noirm.line.adult.5: Watch where you swing that thing, ninja.
villager.noirm.line.adult.6: The training grounds are past the west road, if you're looking for a fight.
villager.noirm.line.adult.7: The hot springs are the best thing about this village. Don't tell the Kage I said that.
villager.noirm.line.adult.8: Lanterns go on at dusk. That's when I head home.
villager.noirm.line.adult.9: They say the faces on the cliff are watching over us.
villager.noirm.line.child.0: When I grow up I'm going to be Kage!
villager.noirm.line.child.1: Can you show me a jutsu? Please? Just one?
villager.noirm.line.child.2: I hit the target three times today! Well, near it.
villager.noirm.line.child.3: Our teacher says ninjas never skip breakfast.
villager.noirm.line.child.5: Are you a real ninja? Where's your forehead protector?
villager.noirm.line.chief.0: Welcome, traveller. Our village is small, but we look after our own.
villager.noirm.line.chief.1: We pay the hidden villages to keep bandits off the roads.
villager.noirm.line.chief.2: If you're staying the night, the inn by the main street has rooms.
villager.noirm.line.chief.3: Pray at our shrine before you travel on. The roads are not safe.
commands.noirm.village.unknown: Unknown size or look. Sizes: capital, town, outpost. Looks: leaf, sand, snow.
tooltip.noirm.weapon.fan: Sneak to throw a fan of three
tooltip.noirm.weapon.explosive: Blows up shortly after it sticks
tooltip.noirm.explosive_tag: Use on a block: goes off after 3 seconds
tooltip.noirm.chakra_blade: Carries your nature: wind cuts deeper, fire burns, lightning numbs, water pushes, earth breaks guards
tooltip.noirm.special.lifesteal: Heals you a little with every hit, and mends itself
tooltip.noirm.special.chakra_drain: Eats your target's chakra and feeds it to you
tooltip.noirm.special.thunder: Lightning numbs what it cuts (2 chakra a hit)
tooltip.noirm.special.swift: Light as a reed: strikes very fast
tooltip.noirm.special.gale: Hits blow enemies back; guard with it to turn projectiles away
tooltip.noirm.special.chain: The chain reaches far and drags your target in
message.noirm.water_walk.sinking: Your chakra gives out: you sink!
message.noirm.sharingan.awakened.ally: Watching your comrade fall, something in your eyes breaks open: the Sharingan! (%s tomoe) — press G
message.noirm.sharingan.awakened.hard_fi: Against a far stronger foe, your eyes refuse to lose sight of them: the Sharingan! (%s tomoe) — press G
message.noirm.sharingan.awakened.pressur: The pressure in your eyes breaks through: the Sharingan! (%s tomoe) — press G
subtitle.noirm.sharingan.tomoe.2: You can see attacks before they land
subtitle.noirm.sharingan.tomoe.3: Watch a jutsu, and it is yours
message.noirm.sharingan.hint.1: Your eyes sting for a moment.
message.noirm.sharingan.hint.2: For a heartbeat, everything seemed to move a little slower.
message.noirm.sharingan.hint.3: Your eyes burn. Something inside them is stirring.
message.noirm.sharingan.hint.4: Your eyes are ready to open. One more desperate moment…
message.noirm.sharingan.hint.hard_fight: Against this opponent, your eyes ache, straining to follow every move…
message.noirm.sharingan.drill_cap: The dummy has taught your Sharingan all it can. Only real fights will make it grow.
message.noirm.sharingan.npc_awakened: %s's eyes turn red: the Sharingan has awakened!
message.noirm.sharingan.npc_awakened.all: Seeing a comrade fall, %s's eyes turn red: the Sharingan!
screen.noirm.eyes.grows: Grows only open and in real fights: landing hits, dodges you foresaw, reading jutsu. Stronger foes teach more.
screen.noirm.eyes.drill_capped: The training dummy has taught your eyes all it can.
screen.noirm.eyes.pressure.1: Your eyes sting now and then.
screen.noirm.eyes.pressure.2: In fights, things seem slower for a heartbeat.
screen.noirm.eyes.pressure.3: Your eyes burn. Something is stirring.
screen.noirm.eyes.pressure.4: Your eyes are ready. The next desperate moment will open them.
screen.noirm.eyes.routes: It awakens near death, watching a comrade fall, in a long fight against a far stronger foe, or when the pressure of many fights breaks through.
command.noirm.sharingan.not_dormant: Only an Uchiha whose Sharingan hasn't awakened has pressure.
screen.noirm.ally.dismiss.tip: Send them on their way (click twice). No hard feelings.
screen.noirm.ally.respect.tip: Respect grows when you fight and win together, teach and look after them. At 70+ they fight harder for you; below 20 they may ignore orders; below 5 they leave.
screen.noirm.ally.xp_next: %s of the way to the next point
screen.noirm.ally.order.follow.desc: Stay at your side and fight with you.
screen.noirm.ally.order.wait.desc: Hold this spot; still defends itself.
screen.noirm.ally.order.meditate.desc: Sit, heal, build reserves and nature energy.
screen.noirm.ally.gear.help: Drag items onto their slots. Shift-click puts armor on and anything else in their main hand. What you give them, they drop if they fall.
screen.noirm.ally.slot.head: Head
screen.noirm.ally.moveset.tip: A kunai, staff or sword in their main hand brings its own moveset; empty-handed they fight with their style (Orders tab).
screen.noirm.ally.loadout.none: Nothing equipped: they pick from everything they know. Equip up to 4 to choose for them.
screen.noirm.ally.loadout.click_remove: Click to take it off the loadout
screen.noirm.ally.loadout.click_add: Click to add it to the loadout
screen.noirm.ally.teach.rules.title: Who can learn what
screen.noirm.ally.teach.rules: A jutsu must be of one of their natures (or universal), its rank needs chakra reserves (B 20, A 35, S 60), and eye or beast techniques can't be taught. Teach them a new nature on the Natures tab.
screen.noirm.ally.natures.title: Their natures
screen.noirm.ally.natures.hint: Pick a nature in the tree. A gold + marks one you own that they could learn from you.
screen.noirm.ally.nature.status.parts: They need both of its parts first:
screen.noirm.ally.nature.status.busy: Finish or stop the current lesson first
screen.noirm.ally.nature.status.you_lack: You don't have it, so you can't teach it
screen.noirm.ally.nature.start.tip: About %s Minecraft days of study near you: full pace under Train or Meditate, half pace otherwise. Fighting together, meditating together and having mastered it make it faster.
screen.noirm.ally.lesson.title: Lesson
screen.noirm.ally.lesson.none: No lesson yet. Pick a nature you own that they lack and press Start teaching.
screen.noirm.ally.lesson.paused.teacher: Paused: you no longer have this nature.
screen.noirm.ally.lesson.paused.order: Paused: order Train or Meditate, or fight beside them.
screen.noirm.ally.lesson.stop.tip: Ends the lesson. Its progress is lost.
screen.noirm.ally.range.close.desc: In their face: close in and throw combos.
screen.noirm.ally.range.mid.desc: Hit and run: step in for a combo, back off while it recovers.
screen.noirm.ally.range.far.desc: Hang back 8–14 blocks: jutsu and throws.
screen.noirm.ally.jutsu_use.conserve.des: Keep half their chakra back and cast half as often.
screen.noirm.ally.jutsu_use.none.desc: Fists and weapons only (a Substitution is still a reflex).
screen.noirm.ally.trait.brave.desc: Fights to the end and respects strength.
screen.noirm.ally.trait.cautious.desc: Backs off early to recover; slow to trust.
screen.noirm.ally.trait.loyal.desc: Sticks with you through anything; trust comes fast.
screen.noirm.ally.trait.proud.desc: Hard to impress: only real strength and victories count.
subtitle.noirm.mangekyo.bond: the loss of someone dear opens your eyes
subtitle.noirm.mangekyo.player: a death before your eyes changes them forever
subtitle.noirm.mangekyo.resolve: at the edge of death, your eyes see deeper
subtitle.noirm.mangekyo.eternal: two lights become one; the darkness lifts
message.noirm.mangekyo.awakened.bond: Grief carves itself into your eyes: the Mangekyō Sharingan.
message.noirm.mangekyo.awakened.player: Watching them fall carves itself into your eyes: the Mangekyō Sharingan.
message.noirm.mangekyo.awakened.resolve: At the edge of death your eyes change shape: the Mangekyō Sharingan.
message.noirm.mangekyo.awakened.command: Your eyes become a Mangekyō Sharingan.
message.noirm.mangekyo.abilities: Pattern: %s. Left eye: %s. Right eye: %s. And Susanoo. (They're in your jutsu list; every use strains your eyes.)
message.noirm.mangekyo.strain.1: Your vision blurs at the edges after using the Mangekyō.
message.noirm.mangekyo.strain.2: The blur doesn't go away anymore. Your eyes ache.
message.noirm.mangekyo.strain.3: The world is dimming. Your eye techniques are weakening.
message.noirm.mangekyo.strain.4: You can barely see. Your eye techniques are failing.
message.noirm.mangekyo.strain.5: Darkness. You are blind. Only another Mangekyō's eyes can give you sight again.
message.noirm.mangekyo.blind: Your eyes are blind; they won't open
message.noirm.mangekyo.tsukuyomi.caught: Tsukuyomi: in this world, three days pass in a moment...
message.noirm.mangekyo.koto.not_a_mind: Only a creature's will can be rewritten, not a player's
message.noirm.mangekyo.izanagi.rewritten: Izanagi: your death becomes an illusion. One eye pays the price.
message.noirm.susanoo.stage.2: Susanoo: arms and torso (use it again to swipe)
message.noirm.transplant.eternal: The eyes merge with yours: the Eternal Mangekyō. Your sight returns and will never fade.
message.noirm.transplant.borrowed: The Mangekyō is yours now, with all it carries.
message.noirm.transplant.upgraded: Your eyes take in the stronger one: %s tomoe.
message.noirm.transplant.implanted: A Sharingan in one eye. It can never close, and it never stops drinking chakra.
message.noirm.transplant.rejected_weaker: This eye is no stronger than yours
message.noirm.transplant.rejected_has_ma: A plain Sharingan is nothing to a Mangekyō
message.noirm.transplant.cant_close: The implanted eye can't be closed
item.noirm.sharingan_eye.hint: Hold use to transplant it into yourself
command.noirm.mangekyo.not_uchiha: Only someone born an Uchiha can awaken a Mangekyō (others need a transplant).
command.noirm.mangekyo.cannot: That can't be done right now.
master.noirm.might_guy.greeting: Ha! I can see the fire in your eyes! Taijutsu is the path anyone can walk, if they train until they drop. Spar with me: show me your guts, and I'll teach you everything I know!
message.noirm.jutsu.needs_gate: Needs an inner gate open (a higher one for the strongest techniques)
message.noirm.jutsu.too_hurt: Your body is too worn out to open the gates
message.noirm.mode.body_spent: Your body gives out: the gates slam shut
message.noirm.master.not_like_that: %s brushes you off: "Want a fight? Ask me for a spar!"
message.noirm.master.time_up: Time's up! %s: "Not yet! Train harder and come back!"
message.noirm.master.passed_down: %s raises a hand: "Enough! You've worn me down!"
message.noirm.master.you_fell: %s stops short: "That's enough for today. Rest, train, and try again!"
message.noirm.master.spar_start: %s takes a stance. Land %s clean hits, or break his guard %s time(s), within %s seconds!
message.noirm.master.test_passed: You passed the test! %s will teach you now.
screen.noirm.master.test.rules: Land %s clean hits or break his guard %s time(s) in %ss
screen.noirm.master.test.safe: He holds back, and nobody gets badly hurt: the spar stops when either of you is worn down.
screen.noirm.master.spar.tip: Start the spar now (combat mode turns on)
screen.noirm.master.why.rest: Rest first: heal up to spar
screen.noirm.ally.teach.master: Only a master can teach this

screen.noirm.ally.job.bodyguard.desc: Sticks close; hunts whoever hurts you.
screen.noirm.ally.job.vanguard.desc: Charges enemies first, from further away.
screen.noirm.ally.job.scout.desc: Walks ahead, marks and reports enemies.
screen.noirm.ally.job.medic.desc: Heals you and the crew with chakra.
screen.noirm.ally.job.gatherer.desc: Picks up loot and brings it to you.
screen.noirm.ally.behaviour.defensive.de: Fights what attacks you or them.
screen.noirm.ally.behaviour.passive.desc: Never starts a fight; backs off when hurt.
screen.noirm.ally.order.guard.desc: Hold a post and fight anything near it.
screen.noirm.ally.order.patrol.desc: Walk around a post, fighting intruders.
screen.noirm.ally.order.post_tip: The post is where you stand (or where they stand, if you're far).
screen.noirm.ally.come.tip: Drop everything and run to you.
screen.noirm.ally.fall_back.tip: Stop fighting and return to you for %s seconds.

handbook.noirm.welcome.body:
This handbook is yours. Read it whenever you're lost; chapters are on the left (arrow keys or click), and the wheel scrolls a page.

You start as an Academy student in plain clothes. Everything else is earned: stats from training and real fights, jutsu from practice, scrolls and masters, natures from long drills, money and rank from missions.

A good first day: switch on combat mode and hit a training dummy, open your jutsu with J, then walk to a village and find its missions board.
handbook.noirm.controls.body:
Fighting happens in combat mode: switch it on, and your mouse buttons become strikes. Combos chain when you press again quickly. Sprint + click is a dash attack, holding back (S) + click a back attack, crouch + heavy a launcher.

A guard raised right as a hit lands is a parry; a dodge right as it lands is a perfect dodge. Grabs beat a guard.

These are your keys right now (change them in Options → Controls → NOIRM):
handbook.noirm.stats.body:
Seven stats make a shinobi. Speed: how fast you move and how slow everyone else looks. Taijutsu: how hard your body hits. Vitality: your health. Reserves: your chakra. Chakra control (CTL): cheaper jutsu, easier water walking. Willpower (WIL): resisting strain. Durability (DUR): a share of every hit you shrug off, up to 60%.

How they grow: hitting the training dummy trains taijutsu and speed, running trains speed, meditating trains reserves, taking hits trains durability. Drills stop teaching at 30: past that only real fights teach, and stronger foes teach more.

Kill XP: beating a ninja gives XP to the stats you used most in that fight (punches, dodges, jutsu, the hits you took), more for a stronger enemy.
handbook.noirm.natures.body:
Your clan gives you one or two natures (fire, water, wind, lightning, earth) and their first jutsu. Others take days of work.

Chakra paper: hold right-click and it reacts to your nature (it splits, burns, gets wet, crinkles or crumbles). A faint second reaction shows a hidden nature: those train twice as fast.

Drills: meditate in the nature's setting. Wind: hold a leaf block. Fire: sit by a flame. Water: by running water or in the rain. Lightning: by a lightning rod or in a storm. Earth: on bare stone, surrounded by stone. A drill is about three in-game days. A crew mate or master who has the nature, sitting near you, speeds it up. /noirm drills shows your progress.
handbook.noirm.scrolls.body:
Every cast earns mastery (★). At ★2 a jutsu teaches the next one in its line. Put up to four jutsu in your loadout with the jutsu screen.

Jutsu scrolls (rank C, B, A, S) come from chests, beaten ninjas and village scroll shops. Reading one teaches a jutsu of that rank of a nature you own. Bigger ranks need more chakra (B: Reserves 15, A: 25, S: 40) and a higher rank (B: chūnin, A: jōnin, S: ANBU).

Nature scrolls are rare: they put a quarter of a nature drill behind you.
handbook.noirm.missions.body:
Every village has a missions board. Right-click it to see the jobs: hunt rogues, escort, deliver, scout. Finish one, report back to any board, and you're paid in ryo and rank points. (Crouch and right-click a board with an empty hand for a new handbook.)

Ryo is your wallet: shops sell in ryo, masters charge for lessons. /noirm ryo shows it; /noirm ryo withdraw puts some in a pouch to hand over.

Rank: Academy → genin → chūnin → jōnin. With enough points, the board offers a rank-up exam (a test spar, a chūnin tournament, a lone hunt and a jōnin). ANBU and Kage candidate come by invitation, after hard missions. Higher ranks open missions, better gear and masters' lessons.
handbook.noirm.crew.body:
Beat a ninja down below a quarter of their health and they yield (kneel). Right-click them to invite them into your crew.

Right-click a crew mate for the ally screen: their gear, what they hold, their orders, style and look, and the jutsu and natures you teach them. Crouch + right-click: wait / follow. The crew orders key gives the whole crew orders at once (posts, come here, fall back, jobs like medic or scout).

Respect matters: winning together and giving gear raises it, hitting them lowers it. Too low and they leave.
handbook.noirm.masters.body:
Masters test you, then teach what no scroll can. Right-click one to talk. Lessons ask for stats, practice, a rank and ryo.

Might Guy, at a Leaf village's training ground: a spar, then the Strong Fist and the Eight Gates.

Rensai the Scholar, in a hidden village's Academy: a jutsu duel, then faster hand seals, cheaper jutsu, a jutsu for each nature, and Nature Insight. Meditate near him to drill any of the five natures twice as fast.

Tsubaki, the Hospital Medic, in a hidden village's hospital: keep a patient alive, then Healing Palm, the Chakra Scalpel, Poison Lore (working antidotes) and safe eye transplants.

The Stone Hermit lives far from any village: see the Sage Mode chapter.
handbook.noirm.sage.body:
Meditating slowly fills you with nature energy. A hermit in a remote sanctuary teaches how to use it (/noirm sage rumour gives a hint where).

His test is stillness: meditate by his pool while restless spirits try to break your focus. Then he teaches you to gather nature energy, to purge it, and finally Sage Mode: pigment marks around your eyes and a strong boost while the energy lasts.

Careful: take in more than your chakra control can hold and your body turns to stone, from the hands up. Let the excess go before it's too late.
handbook.noirm.bingo.body:
Every ninja has a class from D (weak) to S (deadly), shown with their name. Stronger classes are far more dangerous and give far more XP.

The bingo book lists the most dangerous rogues in the world, with a bounty in ryo on each head. Some of them are legends: you'll know them when you see them.

Don't hunt above your class alone.
handbook.noirm.beasts.body:
Tailed beasts roam the world. Beat one down until it lies subdued, then use a Sealing Scroll on it; use the full scroll on yourself to become its jinchūriki, or on someone else. Some are born with a beast inside. Your bond with the beast decides how many tails you can draw safely.

Dōjutsu: Hyūga are born with the Byakugan (see through walls, chakra points). Uchiha awaken the Sharingan near death or in great loss; it grows only in real fights, and can become the Mangekyō. Eyes taken from a fallen Uchiha can be transplanted: do it at a hospital, because operating on yourself can ruin the eye.
